name: Line Chart
accessibility_notes: Provide data table alternative, describe trend in text
description: Best for showing changes over time

name: Bar Chart
accessibility_notes: Label bars directly, provide value labels

name: Area Chart
description: Best for showing volume/magnitude over time

name: Sparkline
accessibility_notes: Minimal: no axes, provide context in label

name: Pie Chart
accessibility_notes: Label slices directly, avoid for >5 categories

name: Donut Chart
accessibility_notes: Center label for total, slice labels
description: Pie variant with center space for key metric

name: Scatter Plot
accessibility_notes: Provide trend line, describe pattern in text
description: Best for showing relationships between variables

name: Heatmap
accessibility_notes: Text values in cells, colorblind-safe palette
description: Best for matrix data and patterns

name: Radar Chart
accessibility_notes: Label axes clearly, limit to 6-8 dimensions
description: Best for comparing profiles across dimensions

name: Funnel Chart
accessibility_notes: Label each stage with count and rate

name: Gauge Chart
accessibility_notes: Show current value, target, and ranges
description: Best for KPI dashboards with targets

name: Sankey Diagram
accessibility_notes: Label nodes and links, describe flow
description: Best for user journeys and state transitions

name: Horizon Chart
description: Best for many time series in small space
